Without the item the heads keep every attempted step, as before. The value check, the trunk, the policy and all exported outputs are unchanged.

g3423_soft_policy.scope: --soft-policy adds the top-level soft_policy block (soft-policy-g3423/1.0.0), step S1 of ai-research/SOFT_POLICY_TARGET_PLAN.md. A trainer-owned Linear(192->1) without bias on the policy scorer's GELU layer (captured by a forward hook on the same forward, so the main logits are unchanged) predicts softmax((current logits + search bonus) / 4) on the teacher term's 128 long-label rows per PPO step. Its loss gets its own autograd.grad call (the head is not among the teacher's actor parameters); the head steps its own Adam (1e-4, clip 1.0) when teaching is on; the actor parameters receive 8 x beta x the soft gradient beside the teacher's, before PPO's clip. Warm-up: the hidden layer is detached for 2 trained iterations, then the trunk multiplier is .2..1 over 5. The head's JSON state is carried in the teacher phase payload as soft_policy. Not exported; no collection, CPU-worker, lab-native or model change. Without the block, behaviour is exactly as before; the teacher term's own loss, gradient, share and beta are unchanged.

g3423_search_auxiliary.scope: --value-revision search-aux adds value_revision.search_auxiliary (search-table-auxiliary/2.0.0). The CPU teacher overlay (lab_cpu_overlay, not lab-native) adds the table's era-end scoring maps to its finish message: recorder.finish(&state.export()), from the recorder the teacher already fed at every transition. With the item on, admission audits them like an ordinary game's (local_scoring_targets.audit_eras), binds them to the table result and keeps them sealed on the table's first root in its search-value shard. The played roots of the search-value training tables admitted in the last four iterations (train tables of G-3..G, and the held-out tables that left the latest 32 in those iterations) are mixed into every PPG batch the era heads train on: each epoch spreads its own permutation (own generator) evenly over the epoch's batches, joint and heads-only, with only the era heads' ownership and local-VP losses, each row weighted as an ordinary row of its step (ordinary rows, their order and accounting unchanged). The search-value validation tables with maps (latest 32) are pooled row by row with the ordinary validation rows into the ownership stop's one owner-CE criterion. Without the item, behaviour is unchanged; the teacher job fingerprint (lab-native sources) is unchanged.

g3471_search_rows.scope: --value-revision search-rows adds value_revision.search_rows (expanded-search-rows/1.0.0; recovery/search_rows.py). Teacher jobs carry teacher_revision.search_rows (changing job ids from adoption); the CPU teacher overlay (lab_cpu_overlay + lab-native-cpu/src/cpu_capture.rs, not lab-native) then encodes, before applying it, the state of every played second main action of a searched turn and, per era, the 24 other played decisions with two or more choices that have the smallest keys of a splitmix64 stream of the job seed and revision (its own stream; no search, policy or exploration draw changes; no new search), and sends them with every candidate revision in its finish message. Admission recomputes the sample and checks turn, seat, cost and state; the rows join their table's search-value shard (keyed by revision; 64-row tables unchanged). Search value: roots keep their targets exactly; an extra row bootstraps at its turn's next root, lambda .95 once per turn; held-out games score every row on its realized utility-to-go; Stage C packs only the drawn rows. Era heads: ordinary rows train on the actual map plus half the lambda .95 return of the heads' own outputs frozen before PPO along each seat chain (PPG sidecar local-bootstrap.npy); search rows (all kinds) on the full return on the turn clock from the heads' predictions at the turn-start roots frozen at the start of PPG, aligned through stable seats; the ownership stop and its pooled criterion score the actual maps. Without the item, behaviour is unchanged; the teacher job fingerprint (lab-native sources) is unchanged.

g3471_soft_policy_weight.scope: --soft-policy-weight 6 sets soft_policy.weight 8 -> 6 with soft_policy.weight_change (generation, before 8). The head, its Adam and warm-up carry over: at the change generation the head state stamped under the weight-8 settings is accepted once and re-stamped at commit. No other soft-policy or teacher setting changes.

g3471_cotton_timing.scope: --update-cotton-timing (training_revision_g3471) moves the g2654 recipe to ordinary-cotton-exploration/5.0.0 and teacher-cotton-exploration/9.0.0: no cotton exploration at the first and last Canal action of a seat or its first two and last Rail actions, and only cotton builds (no cotton develop or cotton-city network) in the last two actions of each era (a seat's action from round and actions remaining; continuations keep it). The same rule in step5.policy/ordinary_cotton (actors and replay audit), teacher_cotton (labels) and the CPU overlay (cpu_cotton teacher, cpu_autoplay ordinary games). Seats are drawn from the new contract's stream; quotas, rates, allowances, labels and buffers are unchanged.

g3471_selfplay_vp.scope: Reporting only: economy.cotton_by_selfplay also sums learner-seat games and final VP for standard and cotton-exploration self-play tables; the iteration log prints the mean VP per learner seat for all, standard and cotton tables; the self-play VP history and chart add the two table types where reports record them.

g3528_rail_end_returns.scope: With search-rows, adopting --value-revision rail-end (weight canal/2) also sets value_revision.search_rows.auxiliary.rail_end = {target: lambda-return, through: rail-era-chain, from_generation}: from that generation (adoption + 4 for a head switched on then, so it first fits the actual map) the Canal rows' Rail-end targets are lambda .95 returns of the heads' own frozen predictions. A Canal row's chain runs on the Rail-end head's predictions and its last Canal row bootstraps at the first Rail row of the same chain (ordinary rows: the seat's next critic row; search rows: the first Rail root) with its Rail prediction and Rail-era return, so it ends at the game-end map. Ordinary rows train on the actual map plus half the correction (channels 9..17 of the PPG sidecar local-bootstrap.npy, 18 channels from then; 9-channel ages read zeros), search rows on the full return. The ownership stop and its pooled criterion keep scoring the actual maps. Before that generation, and without rail-end, behaviour is unchanged.

g3528_drop_rail_end.scope: --value-revision drop-rail-end (needs the era heads with the Rail-end weight 0) sets local_scoring_auxiliary.rail_end_removed to the adoption generation. From then the era heads are local_scoring_v3.TwoEraHeads: the full heads built from the same seed with the Rail-end owner and VP outputs dropped. At that generation only, the committed full-heads checkpoint loses those parameters (zero-initialised and never trained: no loss or preservation term at weight 0) and their slots in the PPO and PPG head Adams, remapped by parameter name; the report records the count and their largest absolute value. No Rail-end output is computed, frozen, preserved or checked afterwards, and rail-end is refused.

g3528_soft_policy_weight.scope: --soft-policy-weight takes 2, 4, 6, 8, 10, 12 or 16 x beta at any committed boundary after adoption. soft_policy.weight_change records the latest change {generation, before} with the earlier one nested as previous, so the settings before each change rebuild exactly; the head, its Adam and warm-up carry over and its state stamped under the earlier settings is accepted once at the change generation. The g3471 block (one change, 8 -> 6) is unchanged.

g3528_cotton_retiming.scope: --update-cotton-timing now adopts the newest reviewed rule (training_revision_g3528, from the g3471 or the g2654 recipe): ordinary-cotton-exploration/6.0.0 and teacher-cotton-exploration/10.0.0. By a seat's action in its era: no cotton exploration at Canal 15 or Rail 1, 2 and 16; no cotton develop at Canal 15 or Rail 15 and 16; no cotton-city network at Canal 14 and 15 or Rail 15 and 16. Against g3471, Canal 1 explores every cotton target and Canal 14 targets cotton develops too. The same rule in step5.policy.cotton_permissions (ordinary_cotton actors and replay audit, teacher_cotton labels) and the CPU overlay (cpu_cotton::retiming for the teacher, cpu_autoplay for ordinary games; lab-native unchanged). Seats are drawn from the new contracts' streams; quotas, rates, allowances, labels and buffers are unchanged; g3471 labels and rows keep their rule.

g3658_iteration_speed.scope: Code-only, no recipe flag; training data, targets, losses, checks that decide training, RNG and checkpoints are unchanged. (1) Collector policy over the iteration (collection_gc, iteration-gc/1.0.0): collection freezes the heap and turns automatic collection off; its end freezes again (O(1)) and resumes young passes with full passes off; the iteration ends with one timed full pass (unreachable reported). BRASS_ITERATION_GC=0 keeps the g3270 window. (2) The scheduled zero-hour cleanup checks sizes at move and deletion instead of hashing 7.5 GB twice, and its purge reuses the plan's reference pins; manual and delayed cleanups keep hashing; restores accept size-only entries. (3) The commit: report.json and state.json are compact JSON; a population member already in its population file is not re-hashed twice per commit (pool planning hashes every member before each collection); the PPG and teacher caches check the state just written instead of re-reading state.json; the commit and trim are timed (timings.commit_seconds, commit_timings). (4) The value phase reuses the acceptance measurements as the gate measurements when both are the current age's held-out games (per-game row counts equal), and skips the masked-descriptor scan when no critic-data controller reads it; the PPG prefetch reports when its hint returned.

g3658_ppg_beta_floor.scope: --ppg-beta-floor 0.125 (training_revision_g3658) lowers the PPG beta floor .25 -> .125 at a committed boundary in both places that hold it: value_phase.beta_clone_min (ppg-value-phase/26.0.0) and the refreshed search-head schedule's Stage C floor ppg_beta_floor_after_stage_b. The first resume under the new floor sets the restored PPG beta to .125 once (ppg_g210 ppg-beta-floor-eighth-hotfix/1.0.0, recorded as the adoption) and keeps the KL trip history, both Adams, RNG, replay and cadence; afterwards beta adapts as before. Recipe projections (training_revision_g3658.previous in previous_recipe and is_shadow) and the transition check accept only .25 -> .125 forward. Collection, labels, search and teacher job ids unchanged.

engine_decision_reuse.scope: CPU teacher search speed, no training change. lab_cpu_overlay.TEACHER_CORE_FILES also copies native/brass-ai-core/src/state/observation.rs and search/reward.rs (and the changed search/brass.rs) into the detached teacher core; a zero-insolvency core's reward.rs patch is re-applied on the copied file. Each search root keeps the decisions it has built, keyed by exact bytes of everything the acting seat can see (all owned state except other hands, the deck order and hidden discard prefixes, plus its recall and the ledger), which refines the permitted view, recall, legal set and ledger of the search key. A repeated decision returns the same shared key, so tree and network-cache equality short-circuit on the pointer; the per-step observation DTO, legal set and full key hash are no longer rebuilt (the leaf still builds its view and legal set once). The key hash covers a cheap subset of the fields its equality compares; the ledger reads public accounts from the owned state and keeps those accounts, not a view copy, at a continuation Finish. Searches, labels, value rows, search rows and every recorded output are bit-identical: core unit tests rebuild every reused decision and compare searches with reuse off; old and new CPU teachers gave identical lab-budget tables. The teacher execution core changes, so ensure_cpu rebuilds the CPU workers; the sealed core and job fingerprint do not.

g4138_teacher_search.scope: --teacher-search-revision (training_revision_g4138, block teacher_search_revision, the user's request of 2026-11-20) at a committed boundary after the g3270 teacher revision: 44 train + 4 validation teacher tables every iteration (g3270 ran 36 + 4) and short teacher searches of 128 simulations at C_scale .6, K 8 (were 96 at .7); the long search (640, K 8, C_scale .2) is unchanged. The qualified teacher_phase, its g1491 marker and count_search are untouched, so the policy-label buffer identity, the long labels, beta and the soft head carry over. The CPU budget follows the recipe (search_profile: collector_runtime.validate_teacher_budget and table admission require fast 128, fast_k 8, fast_c_scale .6; C_scales and the CPU worker's budget parser accept .6). Search value: 48 of a value game's 64 roots are short searches and every return bootstraps from root search values, so the head trains only on games collected from adoption (rotated held-out games included), paused until eight such ages exist; the dedicated held-out check and the era heads' search tables keep every game. Recipe recognition peels the block (is_shadow) and signature_transition projects its adoption; pending work is archived. The continuation rebuilds the CPU teacher (lab-native-cpu cpu_eval.rs changed).

g4288_teacher_group.scope: Code-only, no recipe flag; searches, labels, value rows, search rows and every recorded output are unchanged. Fixed-count streamed CPU teacher tables share one worker process (lab_teacher.TableGroup; lab-native-cpu cpu_group.rs, teacher.rs split into run/run_request by a lab_cpu_overlay patch): each table runs the unchanged single-table teacher on its own thread, pinned by the trainer to its own CPU from the thread id it reports, with its own ONNX session; every session in the process is built on one loader thread that owns the process's prepacked-weights container (cpu_eval.shared_session), so all tables read one prepacked copy of the weights instead of 48 private 17 MB copies (about 440 GB/s of weight reads at g4287). One trainer reader thread tails the group's spool and routes tagged frames to each table's unchanged Worker.collect, in place of one polling reader per table. Exactness: a single table with the shared container equals the HEAD binary bit for bit; three grouped tables equal the same tables run alone on group threads; the lab's focused CPU regressions add test_grouped_tables_equal_single_tables (grouped against one process per table on Linux). BRASS_TEACHER_GROUP=0 restores one process per table. The teacher execution core and the sealed lab-native tree are unchanged; the CPU overlay fingerprint changes, so ensure_cpu rebuilds the workers.

g4475_teacher_training.scope: Recipe revision --teacher-training-revision (training_revision_g4475, top-level block teacher_training_revision), adopted once at a committed boundary, trainer-only: the teacher term draws 160 label rows per PPO step (was 128; g3270.phase_options), still without repeats and width-grouped, and the soft head trains on the same rows; the search-value head's training is paused (no post-PPG pass, no head or trunk steps, no guarded probes, no held-out predictions, no stage advance; head, Adam, stage and lambda kept) while the tables still publish their search-value shards, aged-out shards still retire (ValueBuffer.retire, the same rule buffer.rows applied) and the era heads keep training on the search tables (search-aux 2.0.0, same pool and held-out set). Code-only in the same change: the soft held-out check runs once more after the PPO update and before PPG (teacher_phase.after_ppo; heldout.soft.after_ppo, ppo_delta, ppg_delta, and the policy's heldout.after_ppo from the same forwards), measurement only: no gradients, RNG forked, train mode restored. The collection, CPU teacher jobs and every table output are unchanged.
